data.name: Thekku Island: Blood Dawn
data.detailed_description:
Thekku Island: Blood Dawn is the next major chapter in the Thekku Island universe, delivering a larger, darker, and more immersive survival horror experience. Set deep within the forests of Kerala, India, the game blends authentic regional atmosphere with psychological horror, exploration, and tense survival.

You are sent to investigate the mysterious disappearance of several forest rangers near an abandoned British-era estate hidden deep within the wilderness. What begins as a routine investigation soon descends into a relentless nightmare, where every step uncovers a forgotten secret and every shadow conceals something watching from the darkness.

Built around immersive first-person gameplay, Thekku Island: Blood Dawn combines atmospheric exploration, environmental puzzles, resource management, and psychological horror to create an intense survival experience. Survive the night, uncover the truth, and face the evil that has haunted these forests for generations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
